author: Cleo Abram
description:
When did the FIRST animals appear on Earth? Not bacteria and viruses, but multi-celled creatures!

We know animals were around at least twice as long ago as dinosaurs because that’s how old the oldest fossils we have of any animal are.

But to find out when animals really started, scientists looked at the rate of mutations in a lineage to help them look backwards in time, and found that animals were probably around 200 MILLION YEARS earlier than we thought!

Meaning animals might have been around during “SNOWBALL EARTH”...to see that subscribe!

#animal #earth #history #science #dinosaur

DOI:10.1126/sciadv.aeg6289
title: Guess When The First Animals Appeared
